title: Design Lead - Bangalore, India
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**

*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

**About**
---------

In 1931, an engineering draughtsman named Harry Beck redrew the map of the London Underground. He ignored geography, distorted distance, and reduced the world's most complicated transit system to something anyone could read. Beck understood that when a system gets complex enough, accuracy isn't the same thing as truth. The designer's job is to make the complex legible — so people can decide where to go.  
  
**The role**

Bangalore is one of WisdomAI's largest and fastest-growing engineering hubs, and much of our platform is built there. We're hiring a Design Lead to be a core design partner to that team: owning major product areas, setting the craft bar on everything that ships from Bangalore, and growing into the office's design manager as the team grows.

The work spans our whole platform. Chat on Data, Live Apps, our Slack and Teams apps, MCP, our visualizations, and a major push into agents: always-on teammates for the enterprise, grounded in Wisdom's context engine. Every one of these has to feel like the same product, built by the same hands.

**Design at WisdomAI**
----------------------

**Craft is the product.** People make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration here. It's the product working.

**AI-native by default.** Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We prototype in code, move fluidly between Claude, Cursor, Paper, and Figma, and aren't precious about toolchain. We optimize for velocity and quality.

**Small and senior, on purpose.** With today's AI tools, a handful of exceptional designers can have outsized impact. Everyone here owns real territory, and the team grows only when the bar stays this high. You'll work alongside a designer in Bangalore and the design team in San Mateo, directly with our VP of Design.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Coherence across the platform.** Think in systems from the context engine outward, so a definition, an answer, a chart, or an agent behaves the same way in chat, in Slack, in a Live App, and over MCP.
* **Agents.** Define what a great enterprise agent feels like: how it takes on work, reports back, earns trust, asks before acting, and shows up where people already work.
* **Live Apps.** Customers build anything here: a daily brief that reads like the New York Times, a pricing simulator with deep sensitivity analysis, a dashboard on steroids, a mobile metric tracker. You'll design the best of them, and the templates and primitives that let everyone else build their own — for apps and for agents.
* **The context engine.** Make a deep, powerful layer of semantics, definitions, and governance legible to the people who configure it and the people who rely on it.
* **Data visualization, occasionally.** Our charts are a signature of the product. You'll pick up visualization work from time to time.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own product areas end to end, from customer discovery and problem framing with PMs and engineers through launch and iteration.
* Work side by side with engineers every day. Make design a fast, natural part of how Bangalore builds, not a handoff.
* Prototype early and often with AI tools, building working things rather than static frames, then carry validated concepts through full state coverage and system alignment.
* Set the craft bar in crits and in what ships. Share prompts, patterns, and process with the team.
* Extend our design system so new surfaces arrive coherent by default.
* Partner closely with design leadership in San Mateo across time zones, and help hire and grow the Bangalore design team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years designing products, with a body of work in complex B2B, data, analytics, AI, or developer tools.
* A high bar for craft — visual, UI, and interaction. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter.
* Impeccable taste, and opinions you can explain and defend.
* Sharp product thinking and a talent for taming complexity: you find the simple model hiding inside a sprawling system.
* A systems mind. You've driven coherence across many surfaces, not just polished a single flow.
* You work AI-natively today. You design with LLMs and AI prototyping or coding tools daily, and you can show how they've changed your work.
* You've mentored other designers and earned the trust of engineering teams, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer.
* An interest in data visualization. Experience is welcome but not required.
* You've designed agentic experiences, or templates and systems that other people build with.
* A background in data visualization or analytics.
* Experience on product teams that work across the US and India.

-

**Our CRAFT**

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

**C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

**A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

**T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

-

**Equal opportunity employer**

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Security Engineer Manager, Android Malware Analysis, Android Ecosystem
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience working in one or more of the following areas: security research, malware, reverse engineering.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* Experience leading security engineering teams.
* Experience in vulnerability and exploitation or hacking.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in either one or all is preferred: Software Development, SQL, Code Analysis, Python.

**About the job**
-----------------

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.  
  
You are a recognized expert in at least two security domains and use your leadership skills to manage a team that sets the direction and goals for solving Google-wide problems. You identify fundamental security problems at Google and drives major security improvements in Google infrastructure.
  
  
The Android Anti-Malware team turns big Android malware problems into small Android malware problems. We do this by analyzing upcoming, persistent, or severe malware families and malware categories, and by developing detection and mitigation strategies to reduce the harm they can cause to Android users.  
  
In this role, you will be leading a team of security engineers on the Android Anti-Malware Team. You will be protecting users by investigating and solving malware problems. You will also work with Android security teams, particularly those teams that work on app scanning and Google Play operations, to find new and creative ways to analyze and detect malware at scale. You will help shape the future of Android’s platform security and ecosystem.Android is Google’s mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. Android is about bringing computing to everyone in the world. We believe computing is a super power for good, enabling access to information, economic opportunity, productivity, connectivity between friends and family and more. We think everyone in the world should have access to the best computing has to offer. We provide the platform for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and developers to build compelling computing devices (smartphones, tablets, TVs, wearables, etc) that run the best apps/services for everyone in the world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a team of security engineers (e.g., malware analysts) in Bengaluru.
* Perform reverse engineering, analyze and detect malware at scale.
* Advocate security and secure practices throughout the Google Play and Android ecosystem.
* Conduct research to identify potential attack vectors against Android.
* Work with other team members to improve Android Security knowledge of malware and propose methods to detect and mitigate them.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior Mobile Platform Engineer (iOS)
description:
**SENIOR MOBILE PLATFORM ENGINEER (iOS)**

**We are looking for a Senior Mobile Platform Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**

**Position Snapshot:**

  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**

*By joining Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team, you will be working on the mobile technology powering the Nespresso business.**You will work in a direct-to-customer context with significant volumes and traffic and a very rich feature offering, being part of large development organization with direct impact to online business.*

*As a Senior Mobile Platform Engineer, (iOS) you will be part of the team responsible for designing, building, and evolving the foundational framework that powers Nespresso’s mobile applications. This role sits at the core of our mobile ecosystem, supporting both eCommerce and IoT contexts across the Apple platform landscape (iOS, iPadOS, and aligned devices).*

*You will contribute to shared modules, promote architecture best practices, and ensure consistency, security and scalability across apps built by multiple agile squads. You’ll work closely with technical leads, architects, and product teams to craft performance, modular, and secure SDK that accelerates the delivery of high-quality iOS experiences for millions of Nespresso customers.*

**In This Role, You Will:**

* Own the design, evolution, and stability of shared iOS frameworks and SDKs
* Define and enforce API contracts, architectural standards, and platform guidelines
* Develop and maintain shared modules using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine
* Design scalable modular architectures, including API design and dependency management (SPM)
* Drive adoption of shared frameworks across teams without direct authority
* Own versioning, backward compatibility, and release governance
* Improve developer experience through tooling, documentation, and automation
* Support multiple teams with reusable components and platform guidance
* Ensure high quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD practices

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience and effective communication in English.
* 5+ years of native iOS development experience with Swift and modern iOS stack
* **Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining iOS frameworks or SDKs used by multiple teams in production**
* Strong experience with modular architecture, API design, and dependency management (Swift Package Manager)
* Deep understanding of scalable iOS systems and architectural trade-offs
* Experience supporting multiple teams and driving alignment across a platform
* Experience with versioning strategies, backward compatibility, and release governance
* Ability to clearly explain architectural decisions and trade-offs
* Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Experience working in international, cross-functional teams with Agile methodologies.
* Comfortable working in Agile squads with CI/CD processes and shared Git repositories.
* Passion for creating frameworks, improving developer experience, and enforcing consistency across apps.
* Strong collaboration skills with a focus on documentation, governance, and knowledge sharing.

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership & HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.

In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*

People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

**Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood**

title: Staff Engineer - Cross Border, Mercari India
description:
Introduction

About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

Bold Challenges

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**

Requirements

Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Mercari's JP marketplace domain and internal platforms.
* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

  
**Benefits**

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

Owned Media

* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

Learn about XB and the Global App

* Building one global app platform (XB tech blog)

Related Articles

title: Senior Software Engineer 2 - (iOS, Swift)
description:

GeekyAnts has worked with around 500+ clients all across the globe, delivering tailored solutions to a wide array of industries like Healthcare, Finance, Education, Banking, Gaming, Manufacturing, Real Estate and more. They are trusted tech partners of some of the world's top corporate giants and have helped small to mid-sized companies realize their vision and transform digitally. They are also the registered service suppliers for Google LLC since 2017.

They provide services ranging from Web & Mobile Development, UI/UX design, Business Analysis, Product Management, DevOps, QA, API Development, Delivery & Support and more.

In addition to that, GeekyAnts is the brains behind React Native's most famous UI library; NativeBase (15000+ GitHub Stars), BuilderX, Vue Native, Flutter Starter, apibeats and hold numerous other Open Source contributions to their name. GeekyAnts has offices in India (Bangalore) and the UK (London)

Senior Software Engineer 2 - (iOS, Swift)

Posted a day ago

Not Disclosed

Salary

4+ Years

Experience

Bengaluru, Karnataka

Location

Job Description

You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift — UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
